articles.title: How the credit-reporting system actually works
articles.brief: Mission-angle explainer: the no-consent model (reporting is voluntary, files are automatic, written consent is the exception), furnisher duties under FCRA 1681s-2, bureau reinvestigation duties under 1681i, the real remedies (statutory/punitive damages + fee-shifting under FCRA 1681n/1681o and FDCPA 1692e/1692f/1692k), the Minnesota layer (chs. 13C, 332), and why the dispute paper-trail sequence is the leverage. Case-derived: landlord-debt collectors furnish tradelines tenants must then correct.
